name: rayucode-workspace
description: RayuCode shared TypeScript/React workspace (SDK + shared UI component system for Web and VS Code)

scripts.build:ts: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:ui
scripts.typecheck:ts: npm --workspace @rayu-dev/rayucode-sdk run typecheck && npm --workspace @rayu-dev/rayucode-ui run typecheck
scripts.check:ts: npm run test:sdk && npm run test:ui
scripts.build:vscode: npm run build:ts && npm run build --workspace @rayu-dev/rayucode-vscode
scripts.package:vscode: npm run build:vscode && npm run package:vsix --workspace @rayu-dev/rayucode-vscode
